title: Dominican Devil's Lair
description: A surreal beach scene featuring a tattooed woman in a Dominican flag bikini sitting on a rock at the water's edge, extending her hand toward a blue horned devil emerging from a stone cave. A scuba diver in a full black wetsuit with pink fins floats upside down in the water nearby, surrounded by numerous Dominican Republic flags floating in the sea and sky.
prompt: A surreal tropical beach scene at sunset with palm trees, a tattooed Dominican woman wearing a flag bikini sitting on a rock covered in sea plants, reaching toward a blue demonic creature with horns emerging from a carved stone cave entrance. A female scuba diver in a black wetsuit and bright pink fins is floating upside down in the clear water, surrounded by dozens of floating Dominican Republic flags both above and below the water surface.
